statements.proposition: This change leaves default gateway behaviour unchanged (backward compatible).
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: The PR text says EnforceOrgQuotas defaults to true, but in config/config.go at head it is a plain bool (zero value false) and the Default config literal does not set it. Before the change, RPC storage mode forced EnforceOrgDataAge=true unconditionally; now it is set only if EnforceOrgQuotas is true, so with default config in RPC mode the behaviour changes. Did not run the code; default could in principle be set elsewhere (env/dashboard) but none found in config.go.
